item.title: GTA 6 PS5 Preorders Explode After Netflix Special as PlayStation Pulls Further Ahead of Xbox
item.description: Rockstar Games’ 27-minute GTA 6 presentation sent preorders sharply higher, but the biggest winner was Sony.

item.title: Ubisoft Unveils Rainbow Six Tactics at Gamescom 2026 With Turn-Based Combat, 2027 Release Window for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC
item.description: Ubisoft used Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 to reveal Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics, a new single-player strategy game that trades the reflex-heavy firefights of Rainbow Six Siege for turn-based combat, squad management, reconnaissance, and carefully planned breaches.

item.title: Alan Wake 2 Expansion: The Lake House Arrives October 22
item.description: Alan Wake 2: The Lake House is coming in hot as the final DLC for Alan Wake 2, Remedy’s 2023 survival horror masterpiece.

item.title: Halloween Gaming Sale: Save Up to 90% on Popular Titles
item.description: Granblue, Alien and other games are getting massive price drops this week, with some games slashed by up to 90%.
